chunks: “The testimony of the child against his parent is not accepted.”

key_terms.وَالِدِهِ: his parent, specifically his father or progenitor

ai.seo_question: Is a child's testimony against his parent accepted in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal ruling concerning the admissibility of testimony in cases involving close family relations. It states that a child's testimony against his parent is not accepted, reflecting a jurisprudential restriction in judicial testimony.
